purpose: Machine-citable, normalized ledger of product-owner ratifications HD-01..HD-16 governing the future Evaluate capability. Records WHAT was ratified and its provenance classification, not whether or how it is implemented. It grants no schema, no migration ordinal, no ODS/HPO grant id, and no executable authority. A future Evaluate authority/implementation lane cites this file's ratification ids instead of re-deriving or re-opening the underlying decisions.
precedence_note: This file is canonical for product-owner intent on Evaluate only. It does NOT override executable FIB/ODS/database/security authority, and it does NOT itself authorize hosted apply, production deployment, release, schema, migration, or ODS allocation. Where a ratification here has no corresponding executable authority yet, that is an open implementation gap for a future governed lane, not a contradiction to resolve here.
reopening_rule: THIS IS NOT A NEW HPO. Do NOT reopen or re-adjudicate HD-01 through HD-16. Do not re-litigate any decision below unless repository evidence proves an actual contradiction requiring escalation; absence of implementation is not a contradiction. A conflict between this record and active executable authority fails closed (STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT), it is not silently resolved in either direction.

required_independent_reviews.note: Owner-flagged decisions requiring independent security/legal/operator-boundary review before or alongside any implementation lane that relies on them. Flagging is itself part of the ratification and is not satisfied by this materialization.
